_comments: Out-of-the-box Alternate Base View on MJ: Users: Active users (IsActive = 1).

fields.Name: Active
fields.Description: Users with IsActive = 1. Excludes deactivated user accounts from pickers, assignments, notifications, and active user queries.

_comments: Out-of-the-box Alternate Base View on MJ: AI Agents: Active, non-restricted agents (Status = 'Active' AND IsRestricted = 0).

fields.Name: Active
fields.Description: AI Agents with Status = 'Active' and IsRestricted = 0. Ready for interactive selection, orchestration, and sub-agent delegation.

_comments: Out-of-the-box Alternate Base View on MJ: AI Prompts: Active prompts (Status = 'Active').

fields.Name: Active
fields.Description: AI Prompts with Status = 'Active', excluding Disabled, Pending, and Preview prompts.

_comments: Out-of-the-box Alternate Base View on MJ: Actions: Active actions (Status = 'Active').

fields.Name: Active
fields.Description: Actions with Status = 'Active', excluding Disabled and Pending actions from workflow, agent, and action catalogs.

_comments: Out-of-the-box Alternate Base Views on MJ: Scheduled Jobs: Active jobs (Status = 'Active') and DueNow jobs (derived from Active, NextRunAt <= GETUTCDATE(), CachePolicy = 'Bypass').

fields.Name: Active
fields.Description: Scheduled Jobs with Status = 'Active', excluding Paused, Disabled, Pending, and Expired jobs.

fields.Name: DueNow
fields.Description: Active Scheduled Jobs whose NextRunAt timestamp is non-null and due at or before the current UTC clock (NextRunAt <= GETUTCDATE()). Derived from the Active alternate base view with CachePolicy = 'Bypass'.
